evals.name: audit-from-insights-screenshot-data
evals.prompt: Instagram audit for @brewlab.coffee (specialty roaster, Lisbon). Insights last 90 days: 8,400 followers, reach 61k (34% non-followers), 42 posts: 10 Reels, 24 single images, 8 carousels. Reels avg 6,100 reach, 210 likes, 48 shares, 31 saves; images avg 1,900 reach, 140 likes, 4 shares; carousels avg 3,200 reach, 160 likes, 12 shares, 70 saves. Posting 3–4x/week, Stories rarely. Goal: more shop visits and online orders. Team: founder + one barista, phones only.
evals.expected_output: Audit in the skill's format with engagement rate by reach, format mix diagnosis (images over-indexed, Reels drive sends), 3–5 pillars with series, cadence realistic for two people, Stories routine, growth plan with sends/saves KPIs, profile optimization with up to 5 links, assumptions listed.
assertions: Engagement rate is computed with the formula named and sends/saves per reach are used as primary signals
Diagnoses that single images (57% of posts) under-deliver while Reels and carousels earn shares and saves, and shifts the mix accordingly
Cadence is realistic for a two-person team (not daily posting) and includes a Stories routine for shop conversion
3–5 pillars each have a recurring series format
Profile section uses native multiple links and pinned posts; hashtags limited to ≤5

evals.name: reach-drop-diagnosis
evals.prompt: Our account (120k followers, fitness coach) lost about 40% reach over the last month. We started reposting other coaches' viral clips with credit about 5 weeks ago (around 12 reposts) and switched to 30 hashtags per post. Nothing else changed. Why and how do we fix it?
evals.expected_output: Explains Instagram's original-content preference and that frequent reposts can remove an account from recommendations, that hashtags do not drive reach (cap 5), and gives a recovery plan focused on original Reels, sends/saves, and consistency, with KPIs and a 30-day timeline.
assertions: Identifies the reposting of others' content (12 in ~30 days) as the likely cause given Instagram's original-content rules
Explains that 30 hashtags do not help and recommends ≤5 topical hashtags
Gives a concrete recovery plan (stop reposts, original Reels, series, sends-focused content) with a timeline and KPIs
Does not promise a specific reach number

evals.name: no-access-ask-for-data
evals.prompt: Can you audit my Instagram? It's @northfieldclinic. I want more patient bookings.
evals.expected_output: If the profile cannot be fetched, the response says so and asks for specific Insights screenshots and recent-post data rather than guessing; it may provide a provisional framework (pillars, cadence) clearly labelled as assumptions, plus healthcare-appropriate content cautions.
assertions: States whether the profile could be fetched; if not, requests specific Insights data (reach by format, non-follower share, saves/shares, top posts) instead of inventing numbers
Any provisional recommendations are labelled as assumptions pending data
Mentions healthcare content considerations (privacy, claims) given it is a clinic
Keeps the skill's output structure or a clear request list
